name: postaxis
description: Schedule and publish social media posts from your AI agent with PostAxis: X, Threads, LinkedIn, Telegram, Facebook Pages, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Includes the hosted PostAxis MCP server and a skill for carousels and slides rendered on the PostAxis server.

postaxis.description: Hosted PostAxis MCP server (streamable HTTP). Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to PostAxis on first use.
